reports.fact: Crops grow fast when you sleep through the night, because sleeping skips in-game time.
reports.check: Partly checked. Game data: a growth cycle is 12 in-game hours (720 real s at 24 real min per in-game day), each plot's next update is an in-game time, and sleeping fast-forwards the clock. Not yet measured on a growing crop.
